findings.title: Workflows interpolate SSH secrets directly into run scripts
evidence: docs/AUTOMATION_GUIDE.md:54 states secrets must flow through `env:` blocks
findings.impact: Direct expression substitution places the private key on the shell command line (visible to process inspection and subject to shell interpretation if it contains quotes/metacharacters).
findings.recommendation: Pass the secret via `env:` (e.g. `SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets... }}`) and reference `"$SSH_KEY"` in the script.

findings.title: Lab API /sync ignores the supplied token when the workspace already exists
evidence: tools/lab_api_server.py:150-151 `git fetch` runs without the http.extraheader token
tools/lab_api_server.py:136-144 the token is only applied on the initial clone
Observed: POST /sync with a valid token left the workspace at an older head (2dc93dc) until a manual fetch
findings.impact: Re-sync silently returns a stale commit for private repos, so a scan can be run against the wrong SHA while reporting success.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same `-c http.extraheader=...` (or `GIT_CONFIG_*`) to the fetch, and fail when the requested ref does not resolve.

findings.title: Lab API token passed via process argv and server bound to all interfaces as root
evidence: tools/lab_api_server.py:143 `-c http.extraheader=AUTHORIZATION: Basic <base64 token>` is an argv argument
findings.impact: On a shared lab guest any local user can read the token from /proc; the token authorizes arbitrary command execution as root.
findings.recommendation: Pass credentials through the environment or a temporary askpass, bind to the overlay interface, and run as a dedicated non-root user.

report: Read-only security review of the lab job API (`tools/lab_api_server.py`), the lab-vpn toolkit, and `.github/workflows/*.yml`. No secret values printed. `grep -rn 'secrets\.' .github/workflows/` and manual line reads were used.
